title: Parking Rates
headings: Dorm Resident and 24/7 Student Permit Rates
text:
## General Transportation Announcements
- UMass Boston now offers free e-bike and e-scooter charging at the West Garage Secured Shelter with 13 Saris Power Posts; simply register your bike through Project 529 for Beaconcard access. Learn more about bike parking and facilities .

## Parking Rates
Below you will find prices for parking permits as well as daily parking rates. To purchase a parking permit, please use the parking portal.
On-Campus Lots/Garages : West Garage | Lot D | Campus Center Garage | Quad Lot Off Campus Parking Lot : Bayside
Note: Reserved parking spaces are available in the West Garage only

## Part-Time Faculty Permit Rates
On-Campus Payment Options 15 single-use $150 Payroll Deduction 30 single-use $360 Payroll Deduction Note: Single use passes are only for part-time Faculty and may only be used at gated parking lots and garages. The faculty payment option is pre-tax payroll deductions. 15 single use passes permit parking from 3:30pm onward Monday through Friday or any time during the weekend. 30 single use passes permit parking at any time. All passes expire at the end of the semester. Please use this form to apply for your single use pass.
